name: Smart Energy Meter
desc: A smart energy meter designed to monitor and manage energy consumption more efficiently. We have designed the PCB using ALTIUM tool.

name: Efficient Power Supply (SMPS)
desc: We have designed a Efficient Power Supply (SMPS) of input AC 220 Volts 50 Hz and output DC 5 Volts 40 Amp which efficieny is more than 75% which is stable and having ability to surge current.

name: Website for Coaching Centre
desc: A website developed to manage and promote a coaching center.

name: Adaptive Learning in Education System
desc: An adaptive learning system that personalizes educational content for students based on the feedback. Model will predict the performance of the students by considering the feedback.

name: App for IoT
desc: An application designed to manage and interact with various IoT devices. Where we can information about data analysis, monitor and control the devices associated with the project.

name: E-commerce Product Recommendation System
desc: A system designed to  is deliver product suggestions, enhancing the shopping experience on e-commerce websites by offering personalized recommendations to users based on their preferences and browsing behavior.

name: Recognizing Depression State using Machine Learning
desc: This study uses machine learning algorithms to classify depression based on data features, with the goal of improving diagnosis accuracy and finding hidden patterns in mental health. It uses both supervised and unsupervised models to explore different ways to improve mental health diagnostics and identify possible groups within the depression spectrum.

name: Cloth Wash Prediction using ML & IOT
desc: This system provides weather-based advice on whether it's a good day to wash clothes, using weather data from Visual Crossing's API and location data from IP Geolocation's API. The application also writes the best day and weather conditions to an InfluxDB database for future reference.
